scenes.headline: Down 50%, up 50%, still losing.
scenes.say: Down fifty percent, then up fifty percent, and you're still losing.

scenes.headline: Still 25% below the start.
scenes.say: A hundred falls to fifty. A fifty percent gain from fifty only gets back to seventy-five, still twenty-five percent below where it started.

scenes.title: Gain needed to get back
head: Loss
Gain needed
scenes.say: Losses and recoveries aren't symmetric. A fifty percent loss needs a one hundred percent gain just to get back to even.

scenes.text: Follow for one trading concept a day.
scenes.say: Save this, and follow for one trading concept a day.

post.instagram:
100 falls 50% to 50. A 50% gain from 50 is 75, still 25% below the start. The gain needed to recover is loss / (1 − loss): −10% needs +11.1%, −25% needs +33.3%, −50% needs +100%. That's why keeping drawdowns small matters.

Save this for later and follow @calmedgeofficial for one trading concept a day.
